notes.title: Update May 29
notes.notes:
[list]
[*]Added profile select to game launch.
Player can now choose between 3 profiles when starting the game.
Existing profiles will be in slot Profile 1
[*]Fixed bug with large stacks of objects falling into water causing a crash.
[*]Fixed overworld bug near entrance to Courier New in The Forest.
[*]Changed gamepad menu confirmation button to gamepad A.
[*] Fixed glitch with lighting when first launching play mode.
[/list]

Next up is Steamworks Integration and some additional puzzles.

notes.title: Please Be Kind To The Chickens Live!
notes.notes:
Join the developer and a special guest for an in-depth look into the Please Be Kind To The Chickens demo and a sneak preview into some upcoming content.

Have you ever wanted to be a Yeti riding a flaming chicken?

Are you a historian searching for evidence of ancient chicken-based machinery?

Have you wanted to master the lost secrets of POP (Poultry Oriented Programming)?

Whether your answer is yes or no, you should join us for an in-depth dive into Please Be Kind To The Chickens!
